system.description: The wound bleeds; on your next turn, the foe takes 2 damage that ignores armor. Action. Gut RipperGM intrusions: Your knife gets stuck in your foe and slips from your grasp. Instead of hurting your foe, you accidentally inflict a minor wound on yourself. Your knife sheath is empty and you can't complete the attack.
